entry_points.text: Perf observation provides per event worker plus preemption guarded wrapper, with syscall variant permitting faults, plus sample count and task overrides and probe validation. Syscall update mirrors global flag into task or no ops. Virtualization binds protection change and directory templates. Writeback binds work, plain and control constructors. Failed perf allocation drops silently.

exports.text: Event definition helpers turn a name plus prototype, arguments, layout, assignment and print descriptors into a reusable class and concrete event, with variants for registration hooks, conditional gating, flag and perf permission annotations and syscall specialization. Entry, print and fast-assign wrappers carry fields, format and assignment through, with perf counter and task passthroughs.

Flag rendering pairs numeric values with short names and shows pipe separated lists with none fallback. Covers allocation presets and bits, page state and policy bits, area permission and mapping and control bits, module taint letters, and a lock event helper carrying address space pointer plus write versus read flag.

hazards.text: Signal capture must distinguish no information and privileged kernel sentinels from genuine pointers before dereferencing. Locator words limit offset and length to sixteen bits each, descriptors fix size at four, string copies assume termination byte, formatted output truncates, and array printing accepts only one, two, four or eight byte elements.

Pagemap weights assign one, two, four, eight, sixteen, thirty two and sixty four to mapped, anonymous, file, swap cache, swap backed, mapped disk and buffers. Reclaim uses one, two, four, eight and sixteen for anonymous, file, sync, async and mixed with combined list covering anonymous and file. Power exit reserves negative one. Signal tracing orders delivered, ignored, already pending, overflow fail and lose info.

invariants.text: Allocation display set composes a fixed general part plus optional sanitizer and lock validation parts that vanish when unsupported. Compaction result maps complete to failed, success to progress and all else to withdrawn; with compaction disabled the status, priority and feedback tables emit nothing.

Enumeration to label tables use a two pass pattern where an early pass registers values with tracing and a later pass builds value plus label pairs, with a distinct terminator avoiding trailing separator. Same shape serves migration modes and reasons and general memory flag tables.

String sizing always reserves termination, substituting a shared null placeholder for null sources and copying length minus one plus terminator; bounded and formatted forms follow same rule. Mask storage rounds bit counts up to whole words for sizing and bytes for copy, with cpu mask forms using global cpu count.

Class registration wires system name, fields, init, probe and optional perf and type hooks, marking calls as tracepoints on a dedicated aligned section. Raw output checks entry type with one time warning on mismatch. Writeback group attribution resolves owning group when enabled else reports one. Group number lookup and task work test, set and clear are external dependencies.

locks.text: Event probes run under a non tracing preempt guard. The syscall specialized probe additionally marks a possible fault before taking the same guard, while the generic probe takes the guard directly.

state_machines.text: Emission checks soft disabled destination and returns early without recording, measures variable size, reserves fixed plus variable space returning early on failure, then instantiates layout and assignment and commits. Stages expand in order from entry layout through offsets, output, field metadata, size computation, commit and class rendering, each redefining the macro vocabulary.

structs.text: Each event class yields a raw record with generic header plus class fields plus trailing variable area, with offsets structure and field table companions. Syscall metadata carries name, id, arg count, masks, type tables and enter and exit calls. Device map tracing carries destination via a wrapper holding one network device pointer.

Absolute dynamic locators pack byte offset in low sixteen bits and length in high sixteen bits of one thirty two bit word, offset from entry base. Relative locators use same split but offset from end of the locator field itself. String views read characters and socket views read socket addresses.
